'''Chagras's Blood''' was a type of [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve toxin]] that was created from [[Synedian algae]]. It was developed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]], and in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], she ordered shells containing the toxin to be loaded aboard her [[Warship/Legends|warships]], planning to use the shells to attack surrounding [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] territories.
